shared.noAdminGroups: No active admin signer groups were found for this safe.
shared.safeNotLoaded: The selected safe could not be loaded.

governance.title: Safe Status
governance.pausedDesc: Fund-moving proposals are blocked. Governance stays live — create an unpause proposal to resume operations.
governance.activeDesc: Emergency pause halts all fund-moving proposals while keeping governance available. Use it if a signer key is suspected compromised.
governance.noAdminGroup: No active admin signer group is available for the connected wallet — governance actions are unavailable.
governance.connectWallet: Connect a wallet before creating a governance proposal.
governance.invalidFirstMember: Enter a valid Algorand address for the first member.

create.title: Create Signer Group
create.subtitle: Propose a new standard signer group or a custodian group for a DeFi protocol integration. A new group always starts with one member and a threshold of 1.

errors.noAdminGroup: No admin signer group is available to submit this proposal.

groupType.title: Group Type
groupType.standardDesc: Human or agent signers governed by admins. Supports spending limits and any action set.
groupType.custodianDesc: A protocol contract signer bounded by asset guards. No admin privileges; pay/axfer actions only.

identity.title: Group Identity
identity.firstMemberHint: The group's initial (and only) member. Add more via member proposals after creation.

actions.title: Allowed Actions
actions.custodianDesc: Custodian groups are restricted to payment and asset-transfer actions — their spend is bounded by asset guards set by admins after creation.
actions.standardDesc: Choose which transaction types this group may execute once approvals meet its threshold.
actions.rekeyHint: Also requires group-admin privileges at execution — hands account control to another address.

privileges.title: Admin Privileges
privileges.desc: Admin privileges are safe-wide: a group with these can administer any group in the safe. Grant sparingly.
privileges.policyAdminHint: Change any group’s spending policy and cooldown.

create.adminGroupHint: The connected account must be a member of this admin group to submit the proposal.

manage.loading: Loading signer-group settings from the blockchain…
manage.notFound: The selected signer group was not found.
manage.title: Manage Signer Group
manage.subtitle: Update membership, thresholds, policy controls, and admin permissions through governance proposals.
manage.fixedNameNote: Group names are fixed at creation time. All other supported properties can be updated via proposals from an admin signer group.
manage.adminGroupHint: The connected account must be a member of the selected admin group to submit the proposal.
manage.mayReject: The selected admin group may reject this proposal if the connected wallet is not a member.
manage.custodianNotice: Custodian group — this group is governed by a smart-contract protocol. Asset guards (set by admins) bound what the custodian can spend. It has no admin privileges and uses guards instead of day/month limits. The custodian can self-dissolve once all guards are removed.

members.title: Members
members.desc: Current signer accounts and labels recorded in the group boxes.
members.cannotRemove: Members cannot be removed while the count equals the signing threshold — lower the threshold first.
members.invalidAddress: Enter a valid Algorand address for the member.
members.belowThreshold: Removing this member would drop the group below its signing threshold. Lower the threshold first.

threshold.title: Signing Threshold
threshold.desc: Change how many signatures are required before this group can approve execution.
threshold.label: Threshold

policy.title: Execution Policy
policy.desc: Update allowed actions, asset-based limits, and cooldown rounds for the signer group.
policy.rekeyHint: Rekey also requires group-admin privileges at execution time — it hands account control to another address.
policy.assetHint: The selected asset controls how the daily and monthly limit fields are interpreted and labeled.
policy.cooldownInvalid: Cooldown rounds must be a non-negative integer.
policy.limitsInvalid: Enter valid {{symbol}} limits for the signer group policy.
policy.enableAlgo: Enable ALGO payments when the spending limit asset is ALGO.
policy.enableAsa: Enable ASA transfers when the spending limit asset is an ASA.

admin.title: Admin Controls
admin.desc: Grant or revoke governance privileges and enable or disable the signer group.
admin.activeLabel: Group is active and can participate in proposal approvals and execution.

guards.title: Asset Guards
guards.desc: Per-asset spending ceilings for this custodian. Guards are created, updated, and removed by admin-group proposals; each custodian transfer deducts from the matching guard.
guards.empty: No guards configured — this custodian cannot move any value until an admin sets a guard.
guards.assetHint: ALGO or an ASA the safe holds.
guards.amountHint: Sets (or replaces) the remaining allocation for this asset.

dissolve.title: Self-Dissolution
dissolve.desc: A custodian group can dissolve itself once all asset guards are removed by an admin and the group is pruned to a single member. The dissolve proposal deletes that last member's box with the group.
dissolve.connectWallet: Connect a wallet before proposing dissolution.
dissolve.needSingleMember: Dissolution requires the group to be pruned to exactly one member first (via member removal proposals).
dissolve.guardsWarning_one: This group still has {{count}} active guard. An admin must remove all guards before dissolution can proceed.
dissolve.guardsWarning_other: This group still has {{count}} active guards. An admin must remove all guards before dissolution can proceed.
dissolve.membersWarning_one: This group has {{count}} member. Remove all but one (via member-removal proposals) before dissolving.
dissolve.membersWarning_other: This group has {{count}} members. Remove all but one (via member-removal proposals) before dissolving.

manage.submitFailed: Failed to create signer-group update proposal.
manage.connectWallet: Connect a wallet with access to an admin signer group before managing this signer group.
